name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 11 No 5

clue.text: Islands where there’s talk of lambs eating meat

Suitable for a jar, making bad trouble with Kilner
First musicians at Hastings
West Indian theatre company backed to appear on screen
Then exchange core sections in the coupon

Delete water?
nosey about card-game, with little energy completely 21-ed
Bottom devotee, one found in bird stories
Solemnly admit what’s wrong about clothes
Confounded birds are where flowers should be
Dauphin gives Henry tennis balls, for instance
Devizes (say) person making one mark or other

County and river where Auden lost his tan?
